articles.title: U.S. Dips Into Strategic Oil Reserve Again Amid Supply Disruptions
articles.description: The United States is dipping into its Strategic Petroleum Reserve again, this time to keep crude flowing to a Louisiana refinery while oil prices climb above $117 per barrel. The reserve, meanwhile, is already at its lowest level since 1982. The Department of Energy on Friday authorized an emergency exchange of up to 400,000 barrels to Phillips 66's Lake Charles refinery, citing a temporary disruption to crude deliveries. The oil will come from the reserve's West Hackberry site in Louisiana and is available for immediate delivery. Lake Charles…

articles.description: The United States and Canada are locked in an energy trade war – sort of. articles.title: U.S. Rig Count Holds Steady as Oil Prices Surge
articles.description: The total number of active drilling rigs for oil and gas in the United States remained unchanged for the second week in a row this week, according to new data that Baker Hughes published on Friday, with the total rig count in the US staying at 603, up 53 from this same time last year. The number of active oil rigs rose by 1, to 460 during the latest reporting period, according to the data. This is 40 above this same time last year.
